technology_name: METHOD FOR PREPARING A POTENT COPPER (II) COMPLEX AS AN APOPTOSIS INDUCER IN LUNG CANCER
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Conventional platinum-based chemotherapy drugs like cisplatin trigger extreme cellular toxicity profiles and suffer from high rates of drug resistance in lung cancer patients.
description: The chemical development of an advanced morpholine-appended coordination complex compound that acts as a targeted apoptosis inducer, generating localized reactive oxygen species (ROS) explicitly within malignant cell walls.
applications: Targeted lung carcinoma therapeutics, multi-drug resistant clinical oncology regimens, biomedical cell-signaling research, and advanced pharmacology assays.
